message.content: {"supported":true,"reason":"All factual claims in the post are directly supported by the source text.","claims":[{"claim":"Dubai and World Cities Culture Forum announced the launch of Global Fellowship.","supported":true,"evidence":[0,1]},{"claim":"Global Fellowship program will bring together 20 professionals from different cities, including five representatives from Dubai organizations.","supported":true,"evidence":[2,4,22]},{"claim":"The program aims to develop skills in cultural policy and urban leadership.","supported":true,"evidence":[1,2]},{"claim":"Participants will study, exchange experience, and develop projects for their cities over six months.","supported":true,"evidence":[2,5,17,18]},{"claim":"From November 2026 to March 2027, online masterclasses will be held.","supported":true,"evidence":[16,17]},{"claim":"In spring 2027, a five-day residency will take place in Dubai.","supported":true,"evidence":[19,20]},{"claim":"The program is aimed at strengthening the role of culture in sustainable urban development and improving quality of life.","supported":true,"evidence":[9,10,21]}]}

{"supported":true,"reason":"All factual claims in the post are directly supported by the source text.","claims":[{"claim":"In Dubai, a project has started to implement a unified visual identity and enhanced addressing system covering 186 areas.","supported":true,"evidence":[1,3]},{"claim":"The initiative includes installation of new area identification signs, street name signs, and house number plates reflecting geographic features of each area.","supported":true,"evidence":[2,6]},{"claim":"The first phase will start in the fourth quarter of 2026 and cover more than 2000 signs in five areas including Za’abeel and Nad Al Sheba.","supported":true,"evidence":[3,4]},{"claim":"The colors of the signs are chosen according to the character of the areas, for example, blue for coastal zones and gold for desert areas.","supported":true,"evidence":[5,6]},{"claim":"In the future, the system will expand to bus stops and digital applications with QR codes for the convenience of residents and visitors.","supported":true,"evidence":[7,8]}]}

{"supported":true,"reason":"All factual claims in the post are directly supported by the source text.","claims":[{"claim":"The 15th season of Dubai Miracle Garden has started in Dubai.","supported":true,"evidence":[0,1]},{"claim":"Dubai Miracle Garden is the world's largest natural flower garden.","supported":true,"evidence":[1]},{"claim":"The 15th season is under the theme 'Fifteen Years, Blooming Together'.","supported":true,"evidence":[1]},{"claim":"The season will last until 31 May 2027.","supported":true,"evidence":[1,7]},{"claim":"The season will feature more than 200 million flowers across 72,000 square metres.","supported":true,"evidence":[1]},{"claim":"Each week will have a new theme reflecting the national and cultural calendar of the UAE.","supported":true,"evidence":[1,3]},{"claim":"The weekly themes include events dedicated to Pink October, United Nations Day, UAE Flag Day, and Diwali.","supported":true,"evidence":[3]},{"claim":"The program includes live music, family activities, and sports events as part of the Dubai Fitness Challenge.","supported":true,"evidence":[4]}]}

{"supported":true,"reason":"All factual claims in the post are directly supported by the source text.","claims":[{"claim":"Dubai Municipality launched the initiative ‘A Generation for a Greater Tomorrow’.","supported":true,"evidence":[0,1]},{"claim":"The initiative takes place from 7 to 11 October at City Centre Mirdif.","supported":true,"evidence":[2]},{"claim":"The initiative offers an interactive experience introducing children to municipal work and the importance of city services for everyday life.","supported":true,"evidence":[1,3]},{"claim":"The program includes educational stations on agriculture, safety, communications, digital games, and laboratory experiments.","supported":true,"evidence":[4,5,6]},{"claim":"The initiative supports the UAE’s Year of the Family by encouraging joint participation of children and parents.","supported":true,"evidence":[3]}]}

{"supported":true,"reason":"All factual claims in the post are directly supported by the source text passages.","claims":[{"claim":"В Дубае прошло заседание Высшего комитета по развитию экономического и финансового секторов, на котором обсудили последние показатели и стратегические направления развития.","supported":true,"evidence":[2,11,14]},{"claim":"Эмират занял первое место в мире по FinTech.","supported":true,"evidence":[5]},{"claim":"Эмират улучшил позиции в профессиональных услугах и репутации на мировом финансовом рынке.","supported":true,"evidence":[5]},{"claim":"Число лицензированных провайдеров виртуальных активов достигло 52.","supported":true,"evidence":[5]},{"claim":"Объем торгов виртуальными активами составил около AED7,43 трлн за год.","supported":true,"evidence":[6]},{"claim":"Рынок акций Дубая демонстрирует рост с капитализацией почти AED993,1 млрд.","supported":true,"evidence":[6]},{"claim":"Рынок акций привлек более 55 тысяч новых инвесторов.","supported":true,"evidence":[7]}]}

{"supported":true,"reason":"All factual claims in the post are directly supported by the source text.","claims":[{"claim":"Власти здравоохранения Дубая приняли 49 студентов в 11-й набор программы Tibb wa Uloom, направленной на поддержку эмиратских студентов в области медицины и смежных наук.","supported":true,"evidence":[0,1]},{"claim":"Программа охватывает выпускников школ и студентов вузов, желающих изучать медицинские специальности.","supported":true,"evidence":[1]},{"claim":"С момента запуска в 2016 году в программе приняли участие 618 студентов, из которых 297 уже выпустились.","supported":true,"evidence":[1]},{"claim":"Женщины составляют 84,8% участников.","supported":true,"evidence":[2]},{"claim":"Около 60% студентов обучаются медицине.","supported":true,"evidence":[2]},{"claim":"Программа включает новые направления, такие как общественное здравоохранение, чтобы соответствовать приоритетам сектора.","supported":true,"evidence":[3,4]}]}

{"supported":true,"reason":"All factual claims in the post are directly supported by the source text.","claims":[{"claim":"ISEA2026 will be held in Dubai from 6 to 15 November 2026.","supported":true,"evidence":[1]},{"claim":"It is the 31st International Symposium on Electronic/Emerging Art.","supported":true,"evidence":[1]},{"claim":"The theme is ‘ELYAH: Constellating Place, Data and Identity’.","supported":true,"evidence":[1,14]},{"claim":"The event will be held in a hybrid format with exhibitions, performances, and an online program.","supported":true,"evidence":[3,4,7,8]},{"claim":"The program covers more than 20 venues across the city.","supported":true,"evidence":[8]},{"claim":"The program includes over 140 academic papers, 40 artist talks, 15 workshops, and special tracks including digital calligraphy and eco-tech.","supported":true,"evidence":[6,7,9,14,17]},{"claim":"The symposium supports the development of digital art and strengthens Dubai's international cultural status.","supported":true,"evidence":[2,3,10,11,13]}]}

{"supported":true,"reason":"All factual claims in the post are directly supported by the source text.","claims":[{"claim":"Международный космический центр имени Мохаммеда бин Рашида (MBRSC) и Управление ООН по вопросам космоса (UNOOSA) объявили о начале приёма заявок на участие в третьем этапе инициативы Payload Hosting Initiative (PHI-3).","supported":true,"evidence":[0,1]},{"claim":"Программа предоставляет возможность испытать инновационные космические технологии на платформе 12U CubeSat.","supported":true,"evidence":[2,3]},{"claim":"Заявки принимаются до 6 апреля 2027 года.","supported":true,"evidence":[12]}]}

{"supported":true,"reason":"All factual claims in the post are directly supported by the source text.","claims":[{"claim":"Dubai Cashless Strategy, launched in October 2024, reached 90.1% cashless transactions, exceeding the 90% target for 2026.","supported":true,"evidence":[1,2]},{"claim":"The Digital Enablement Index for the government sector reached 100%.","supported":true,"evidence":[3,15]},{"claim":"The community happiness index reached 90.1%.","supported":true,"evidence":[4]},{"claim":"Cashless payment initiatives contributed more than AED 8 billion to Dubai's economy.","supported":true,"evidence":[7]},{"claim":"The strategy is based on partnerships among government entities, financial institutions, and technology companies, supporting digital economy development and enhancing Dubai's competitiveness as a global business and tourism hub.","supported":true,"evidence":[6,11,12,13]}]}

{"supported":true,"reason":"All factual claims in the post are directly supported by the source text.","claims":[{"claim":"The Rental Disputes Centre in Dubai settled 2,350 cases in the first nine months of 2026.","supported":true,"evidence":[0,1]},{"claim":"The total value of the settled cases was AED 401 million.","supported":true,"evidence":[0,1]},{"claim":"The average resolution time per case was six days.","supported":true,"evidence":[1]},{"claim":"Conciliation procedures allow landlords and tenants to reach agreements without litigation, reducing social and economic costs.","supported":true,"evidence":[1]},{"claim":"Settlement agreements are approved by a supervising judge, giving them legal enforceability.","supported":true,"evidence":[1]}]}

{"supported":true,"reason":"All claims in the post are directly supported by the source text.","claims":[{"claim":"Mohammed Bin Rashid Housing Establishment organized an interactive stand at Dubai Festival City Mall.","supported":true,"evidence":[1]},{"claim":"Visitors can learn about housing services and solutions and speak with specialists.","supported":true,"evidence":[1,2]},{"claim":"Dubai Islamic Bank participates with a dedicated section offering joint services.","supported":true,"evidence":[2,3]},{"claim":"There are contests, prize draws, and interactive activities creating an engaging and entertaining atmosphere.","supported":true,"evidence":[3,4]}]}

{"supported":true,"reason":"All factual claims in the post are directly supported by the source passages.","claims":[{"claim":"The 28th WETEX exhibition will be held from 20 to 22 October 2026 at Dubai World Trade Centre.","supported":true,"evidence":[1]},{"claim":"WETEX 2026 is organized by DEWA under the patronage of Sheikh Ahmed bin Saeed Al Maktoum.","supported":true,"evidence":[1,2]},{"claim":"Special focus will be on health and safety at the workplace using artificial intelligence and new technologies.","supported":true,"evidence":[3,5]},{"claim":"The Health and Safety Hub will host a conference with global experts discussing innovations in occupational health, risk management, and quality of life improvement.","supported":true,"evidence":[3,4,5]},{"claim":"Conference topics include AI ethics, digital employee wellbeing, and the use of robots for safety.","supported":true,"evidence":[5]}]}

{"supported":true,"reason":"All factual claims in the post are directly supported by the source text.","claims":[{"claim":"The Ripe Market reopened in Dubai Police Academy Park in Umm Suqeim.","supported":true,"evidence":[1]},{"claim":"The reopening marks 15 years of bringing local businesses and communities together.","supported":true,"evidence":[1,18,19,20]},{"claim":"Visitors can find stalls with clothing, jewelry, organic products, and handmade items.","supported":true,"evidence":[3,4,5,6]},{"claim":"The market offers various family entertainment activities.","supported":true,"evidence":[15,16,17]},{"claim":"The program includes workshops, children's attractions, live music performances, and shows.","supported":true,"evidence":[15,16,17,18]},{"claim":"The market features sports and wellness activities.","supported":true,"evidence":[18]},{"claim":"Dubai Police organize demonstrations and activities for children at the market.","supported":true,"evidence":[17]},{"claim":"The market operates on weekends from 9:00 to 21:00 until May 2 of the following year.","supported":true,"evidence":[1,20]}]}

{"supported":true,"reason":"All factual claims in the post are directly supported by the source text.","claims":[{"claim":"Dubai Police received international recognition from the Project Management Institute (PMI) for excellence in planning and delivering projects.","supported":true,"evidence":[0,1]},{"claim":"The recognition was announced during the PMI Global Summit Series in Seoul.","supported":true,"evidence":[1]},{"claim":"The recognition highlights the effectiveness of Dubai Police's project management system based on planning, resource management, and performance evaluation.","supported":true,"evidence":[1,2]},{"claim":"Dubai Police initiatives and projects aim to achieve strategic goals with measurable impact.","supported":true,"evidence":[1,2]},{"claim":"Major General Sheikh Mohammad Abdullah Rashid Al Mualla stated that the recognition confirms the maturity of institutional practices and professionalism of personnel.","supported":true,"evidence":[2]}]}

{"supported":true,"reason":"All factual claims in the post are directly supported by the source text.","claims":[{"claim":"Dubai doubled the Oraseya Capital fund to AED 1 billion.","supported":true,"evidence":[0,1]},{"claim":"Oraseya Capital is managed by Dubai Integrated Economic Zones Authority.","supported":true,"evidence":[1]},{"claim":"The fund was increased from AED 500 million to AED 1 billion to support companies in AI, fintech, and future technologies.","supported":true,"evidence":[0,1]},{"claim":"The maximum investment per company increased from 3 million to 6 million USD.","supported":true,"evidence":[5]},{"claim":"The increase in investment size will allow support for more mature projects and expand investments internationally.","supported":true,"evidence":[5,6,7]}]}

{"supported":true,"reason":"All claims in the post are directly supported by the source text passages.","claims":[{"claim":"В жилищном учреждении Мухаммеда бин Рашида (MBRHE) запустили специализированную зону для \"Поколения Формирователей\" — матерей, играющих ключевую роль в воспитании будущих поколений.","supported":true,"evidence":[0,1,2,3,4]},{"claim":"Инициатива направлена на улучшение обслуживания и удобство доступа к услугам MBRHE.","supported":true,"evidence":[2,3]},{"claim":"Инициатива поддерживает цели Года семьи ОАЭ 2026 по укреплению семейных связей и общества.","supported":true,"evidence":[5]}]}

{"supported":true,"reason":"All factual claims in the post are directly supported by the source text.","claims":[{"claim":"AquaIndex plans to launch a water token in the UAE.","supported":true,"evidence":[0,1,8]},{"claim":"AquaIndex announced plans to create a regional water token for the UAE as part of global expansion.","supported":true,"evidence":[0,1,8]},{"claim":"The platform for managing and trading water resources based on real-world asset tokenisation will launch in Q4 2026.","supported":true,"evidence":[2]},{"claim":"The tokens will be backed by physical water reserves from a regulated aquifer in the USA.","supported":true,"evidence":[5]},{"claim":"Water delivery is possible through existing infrastructure.","supported":true,"evidence":[5,7]},{"claim":"Partnership with DMCC will help develop digital infrastructure and the water resource market in Dubai.","supported":true,"evidence":[1,2]}]}

{"supported":true,"reason":"All factual claims in the post are directly supported by the source text.","claims":[{"claim":"In Dubai, submissions opened for the AI Film Award 2027 with a $1 million prize.","supported":true,"evidence":[0,1,7]},{"claim":"Submissions started on 12 October for the second AI Film Award 2027 contest.","supported":true,"evidence":[1,6]},{"claim":"The contest will be held as part of the 1 Billion Followers Summit in Dubai from 8 to 10 January 2027.","supported":true,"evidence":[1,7]},{"claim":"The contest offers a $1 million prize for films created with AI on humanitarian, social, and environmental issues.","supported":true,"evidence":[1,2,3]},{"claim":"Submissions are accepted until 20 November 2026.","supported":true,"evidence":[6]},{"claim":"The winner will be announced at the summit in January.","supported":true,"evidence":[1,7]}]}
